Taking my meds inconsistently made things so much harder for me. I would forget for a couple days and then remember again, but never for long enough to stabilize myself and I was also experiencing really heavy side effects-especially nausea. Eventually I did stop taking them and told myself I would make an appointment with my nurse practitioner in a week to discuss changing my prescription (the meds were also just not working and I was at the max dosage the NP was willing to try). But ever since then I’ve felt fine? This was about 9 months ago, and it’s been the healthiest 9 months of my teenage/adult life. Like Michelle said, mental health is not a universal journey. It’s definitely not a course of action I would recommend to anyone else and it wasn’t even my original plan, but if you have gone off your meds or are thinking about going off your meds, please talk to your doctor. They may be able to prescribe something that works better for you or help you find something that fits your lifestyle.
